purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: Dayforce Candidate Portal (jobs.dayforcehcm.com). <job>/apply shows 'Already Have an Account? Sign In' vs 'Apply without an Account'. The guest path opens a 3-step 'Manual Application' (Candidate Info -> Questionnaire -> Submit). Step 1 was observed blank on 3 employers; the Questionnaire and Submit steps are gated behind required step-1 fields and reCAPTCHA and were NOT visited. DeVry's /apply redirected back to the job page (no guest option reachable).

blockers.detail: Buttons need a pointerdown..click event sequence; plain click() and bridge clicks are ignored; navigation completes 6-10s later.
Questionnaire/Submit steps need step-1 completion + reCAPTCHA.
DeVry /apply redirected to job page — guest path unavailable.

runtime_observations: Duplicate ids for the resume file input (visible + hidden). Bind to the visible one.
Option captures accumulate across dropdowns; de-duplicate.
Section order varies per tenant (Resume first vs Personal Information first).

inferred.questionnaire_inference: Dayforce questionnaires are per-requisition; expect Yes/No, single-select and free text. UNVERIFIED.

provider_hint.for_jev: Dayforce guest Manual Application: step 1 is contact + address + source + resume + optional education/employment sub-forms. Native required attributes are reliable. Combobox options known for prefix/contact method/source; country/state lists standard. Questionnaire step is unobserved — request re-observation before answering. Stop at any 'Submit'.
